name: wpf-locator-doctor
description: Score a WPF app's testability, explore the running app, and get ranked, checked UI-test locators and AutomationId fixes.
long_description: Lets your AI assistant check and fix how testable a WPF app is. UI tests (FlaUI, Appium, WinAppDriver) find controls by their AutomationId. Score a project from its source (0-100, A-F), list locator problems with file and line, and plan exact XAML fixes. With the running app: see the screen as test tools do, get ranked locators with reasons and FlaUI/Appium code, check that a locator finds exactly one element, click, type, select, wait, take screenshots and score the live app. Needs the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime (or newer).

allowed_apps.title: Allowed apps
allowed_apps.description: Optional. Names of the apps the tools may start or attach to, separated by semicolons (e.g. MyApp;PracticeApp). Leave empty to allow any app.
